title: UNVERIFIED — The Empty Platform at Fassifern

features.name: a hologram skirt
features.desc-on-touch: A flickering incandescent starfield, worn in palm tree food courts across the pinball coast of the northern seaboard. Really much more like a beach scene: a shifting of biogenic light.

features.name: a blue grid, mostly blank
features.desc-on-touch: The front of every Master System box in the video store, so you would pick it up and turn it over. Also a tartan picnic blanket somebody snoozes on during daytime operations.

features.name: chilli con carne, remembered
features.desc-on-touch: Ten years on, the golden record idea feels like a quaint thing to say. Yet there is little he would rather live again than slow cooking chilli con carne with her.

features.name: the platform sign
features.desc-on-touch: Nobody on it. The train holds a moment, then does not.

inscription: not so it can be rebuilt, but so it can be reevaluated

file.note: Enough text, sound and imagery for any young Blinky Bill out on the road after. The mandate, as first written.
